node.title: rel2abs of a path with tilda
node.author: ovedpo15
node.doctext:
Hi Monks,
I have a bunch of paths and for each path I want to convert it from relative path to absolute path. For that I use the rel2abs method. But I noticed a corner case where I have a path that starts with tilda ~. In that case I get: rel2abs ~/.test /abc/site/disks/home_user/asdas/~/.test Where the actual path is: /abc/site/disks/home_user/asdas/.test How do I treat this special case?
